notes.title: Nemesis update 1.0.0.7
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/4b5a80ff4aaca5c7af6991c4a1a21c8527071d17.jpg

Requested features


 Adding dice roll during an attack.


Bug fixes


 Fixing game freezing after kicking a player.
 Fixing achievement for completing the tutorial.
 Updating untranslated texts in other languages.
 Correcting individual typos.
 Adding a message and achievement in case of server interruption by AWS.



We kindly ask you to report any bugs directly through the game's "bug report" feature. When you report an issue this way, you send us the entire gameplay history, which greatly facilitates diagnosing the problem. We appreciate your cooperation and thank you for helping us improve your gaming experience.

Bug under investigation


 When you have enough knowledges to access "herding" weakness , you can't use pc action or reagant to chase the intruders back into vent and instead it got stuck.
Has been checked, works well, more tests are needed to encounter the issue that players report.
 Fix intruder attack cards, e.g.: Blood Chase sometimes trigger, sometimes just don't, even if the attacked escaping player clearly has undressed Serious Wounds.
The code was checked, we did not find any rules that could cause the problem. More time and tests are needed.
 Fix intruder attack cards, e.g.: Blood Chase sometimes trigger, sometimes just don't, even if the attacked escaping player clearly has undressed Serious Wounds.
Here, the problem was found, but the place where it can be fixed is quite sensitive and may interfere with many elements in the game. At least 2-3 days of testing are needed to see if it works well and doesn't break anything.


Important announcement

We've thoroughly analyzed all the crash reports you've submitted on Discord. Our findings revealed that these incidents were not crashes in the traditional sense but rather interruptions of the AWS spot instances on Steam. For clarity, spot instances are a cost-effective solution provided by AWS that allows us to bid on unused computing capacity at lower prices. However, the trade-off is that these instances can be reclaimed by AWS with very little notice, leading to the interruptions you've experienced. This approach has been vital in managing our budget constraints and continuing to deliver our game to you.

We recognize that many were not aware that these "crashes" were actually due to the termination of spot instances, a situation over which we, as the development team, have no control. Despite these challenges, we want to assure you that we're dedicated to improving how we communicate such incidents. With the latest update, we will introduce better notifications to inform players in real-time if their game session is at risk due to spot instance reclamation.
Additionally, as a gesture of our appreciation for your understanding and to acknowledge the unique challenges posed by these interruptions, we're introducing a special achievement: "Apocalypse Survivor" This achievement is not only a token of the extraordinary circumstances you've endured but also assists us in collecting crucial data to further analyze and potentially mitigate the impact of such interruptions in the future.

Please understand that, given our current budgetary limitations, we do not have the capacity to reduce the frequency of these spot instance interruptions. However, we are committed to making your gaming experience as smooth and enjoyable as possible within these constraints.
We're grateful for your patience and continued support as we navigate these challenges together. Your feedback is invaluable, and we remain committed to transparent communication and improving the game based on your insights.

Thank you for being such an integral part of our gaming community.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.5 - New languages update!
notes.notes:
Hi Crew,

This is a crucial transmission. The newest update for Nemesis: Lockdown features a cargo full of new additions. Read on for a detailed description accompanied by graphic assets or scroll down to see a summary of this update.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/314ab08089a628b389e72df6402571e8d4c9bfe5.png

New Languages
Surviving isn't easy when you're on a space station filled with aliens crawling about, we know that. That's why with this patch, our main goal is to bring more survivors on board! In order to do so, we've added 4 new languages to the game! These are:

 Chinese
 German
 Polish
 French

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/70353d26f07862f86516daa9a9ad00521c6327fd.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/ee4eba1c2b7a9b4578fe5fd81b0f1565405ef78f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/11a33f99af6ce973eea82c3a70d51c2292977d38.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/ea5456b27e86f05a1fe74e5a17be4b96d3bfeb00.jpg

Updated ranking system and seasons
All recruits, both new and old, are in for a threat as well, because we've prepared an overhauled ranking system, which will be governed by seasons going forward. Each season will last one month and to make it easier to follow, we've also added a graphical representation in the form of a timeline. We feel that with this addition, the challenge of getting to the top of the rankings will be a one that's more demanding, but also more rewarding. Here's how the new system looks in the game:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/c7ceaacd991ba872e0bc308993d64d427c4e2b77.png

Updated animations
We thought that some of the animations were in need of a slight rework, and there are 2 in particular that we've reworked in this patch. These are:
- the vivisection animation
- the contamination card scanning animation
Here's a look at the first one - look how satisfying it now is to fire a laser on an unsuspecting intruder:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/2e847da681ffaa7b1f09f3bd4de31595a3be89a5.gif

Patch summary
Here's a TLDR version for all of you who prefer getting straight to the point:
New languages

 Chinese
 German
 Polish
 French

New ranking system

 Season systems added
 Visual timeline added

New animations

 Vivisection animation updated
 Contamination card scanning animation updated


We wanted to thank you for the continued support and remind you to share your thoughts on the game in the Steam discussions. You're also invited to join our official Discord server - click on the banner below to join fellow recruits, find parties and chat about the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/600277a0698fdc0cd656b98577932b295b91bf44.png

Have fun playing! Over and out.

notes.title: Nemesis: Lockdown v. 1.0.0.3 patch notes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/cf4ad6bae39fa42bbbd6542520ca91c48ea56b69.gif

Survivors - transmission incoming,

Patch v. 1.0.0.3 is here and it’s a cargo full of improvements and fixes. In order to make the game as approachable as possible, we set our sights on some quality of life changes that we think will improve the overall experience. Also, we can’t afford to have too many bugs in the base. You’ll have your hands full dealing with the Intruders, that’s why we got rid of some of the bugs for you. Besides that, there’s also a bunch of fixes that correct and smooth out the gameplay, along with achievement fixes for all of you who like to hunt achievements alongside being hunted by alien threats.

If you’re interested in what specifically has been fixed and implemented, below is the full list of changes:


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/314ab08089a628b389e72df6402571e8d4c9bfe5.png

Improvements:

 Improved game optimization
 Fixed many instances of the game crashing
 Fixed most crashes when loading the game
 Implemented network connection optimizations
 Implemented text and typo corrections
 Changed the server list display
 Added a view of the last 20 completed games.
 Added option to join the waiting server directly from a web browser
 Added information about rooms that were peeked at by other players
 Disabled the ability to zoom in game map when in the Menu or Manual
 Changed the appearance of Dynamic Benchmark icons in the settings
 Fixed bugs related to changing resolution and windowed mode
 Added a new Graphic Option - focal length.
 Added a new Graphic Option - camera aperture.
 Added the ability to change keybinds for camera movement and rotation


Gameplay Fixes:

 The negative effect of the Knee Wound is now active only once for the round
 Fixed the Weird Metabolism action - Contamination card is now placed in the discard deck
 Changed the Action Cost of picking up items (not objects) to 0
 Removed the Hand Wound effect on the activation cost of Quest Items


Bugfixes:

 Fixed a bug that froze the game after using careful movement to move into a room with danger/silence exploration token, while having a slime marker
 Fixed the Survivor's Distraction action not working properly when canceled and started again
 Fixed the Isolation Room action - the game now always waits for a dice roll to finish before letting the player end the game
 Fixed the Drive to Bunker action
 Fixed the cost of picking up an object (you are now unable to make 3 actions in a row)
 Fixed issues with interactive elements when canceling the Corridor/Door selection action
 Fixed the instance in which the player wasn't able to click or swap the CSS token when using the CSS Control Room action
 Fixed the issue of items not being removed after use when viewing the item panel
 Corrected the description of the Fire in the Hole event
 In the Panic Panel, renamed the Choose Item button to Delete Item.
 Fixed a missing item title in tutorial
 Fixed the output of information about the player's action when they open the door using the computer's action
 Disabled arrows in corridors at the start of the game
 Fixed the Enviro Suit and Battle Suit not displaying on characters after reconnection
 Fixed typed text not showing up during character selection after launching the game for the first time
 Fixed the loading screen during reconnection
 Fixed an instance of the game not loading properly after reconnection
 Fixed a bug of the game not displaying the Event Phase after reconnection
 Fixed noise tokens showing up at the start of the game
 Implemented improvements to music and sounds
 Characters now turn towards the Room Action Element


Achievement Fixes:


 Fixed the “Unwanted pet” achievement.
 Fixed the “Martial Arts” achievement.
 Fixed the “Dodge this” achievement.
 Fixed a bug that caused intruder kills to be counted twice in achievements when melee killing them.
 Fixed the achievement "Oxygen not included" being awarded to the wrong player.
 Updated the "Facility Defender" achievement description from Vent Control Room to Defense Control Room.
 Disabled getting the "Scrambled eggs" achievement for the first player if the Nest was destroyed by fire when the room was set on fire by Consuming Fire or an exploration token and was not previously extinguished.
 Fixed an instance where we were not getting achievements that we earned at the end of the game.
 Fixed the Intruders kills counting achievement by triggering Self-Destruct.


Hopefully, these will make your Lockdown experience better on many levels. As always, your feedback is welcome as it helps us in making the game better, so please keep sending it in.

Make sure to join our discord server to leave feedback, stay up to date with all the newest information and chat with other survivors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/600277a0698fdc0cd656b98577932b295b91bf44.png

Over and out, survivors.

notes.title: MAJOR Update before LOCKDOWN begins! FULL RELEASE in 2 days!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/7627af7dac2d3def6be42fb1034901e3894313be.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/91c5fff91877c31bdd8642350f77ab12bbc22c7f.gif

Hey Everyone! 

It’s been nearly half a year since we started our survival attempts on the Martian base in Nemesis Lockdown. Gosh… how time flies! From a developer perspective, it was a period full of challenges and lessons learned.!

Since the very beginning of Early Access, its main purpose was to make the title as approachable as possible for everyone. Achieving this, while maintaining the unique atmosphere of the board game counterpart, proved to be a real challenge. Despite that, we think we were able to make it happen and that is in no small part thanks to your feedback and support!

We’re proud of what we’ve accomplished together over the last few months - today, we’re SUPER excited to show you the Lockdown we’ve all been waiting for!

Before we move to the main part of the update, check out the cinematic trailer for the game:

[previewyoutube=e1UVB5ywTBQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Now, it’s time for all the new fun stuff and changes we've prepared for the full release!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/308fc5755887dfbdded1e1f455d72a8bf5f4003a.png

Basically, almost every element of the game has been changed or polished in one way or another. Our current EA players will find major or minor upgrades pretty much everywhere. As for the new players, we believe that thanks to these updates, they will find the game intuitive and easy to get into.

To avoid making this update being unnecessarily long, we'll describe what’s changed in a general manner. 
A detailed changelog will be posted in-game menu on release day and you’ll be able to access it from the main menu. We believe that (re)discovering the game can be pretty fun, but if you want to know all the details from the get go, you’ll be able to do so as well!

Let’s get started!

Fully-fledged tutorial with a mini scenario!

Yeah, that's correct - no more external videos to learn how to play the game! 

Games from the Nemesis series are quite complex and unpredictable gameplay-wise. Executing actions, understanding the situation on the board, fulfilling objectives and surviving - all of this can potentially be quite hard to tackle for beginners. That's why we thought long and hard on how to improve the ease of entry and flatten the learning difficulty curve. The tutorial is the result.

Check out what we’ve prepared in 3 Special Scenarios below:

 The first 2 work similar to a traditional video game tutorial sequence, in which - with a narrator’s help - you’ll learn the basics of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/18eadb3af763a076ab033f33c3bc469b54617049.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/965e9f6a97ee348f4937f6d1118b03c109479641.png

 The 3rd scenario is more like a playground with tailored Objectives - you’ll need to use all previously learned skills to get the job done and survive. You’ll be able to get to know Lockdown’s  rules on your own here. This chapter has 2 difficulty modes:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/0d276fe388535702bfb0250d366870dab4ec5e35.png

 To be completely honest with you, though - This is Nemesis, so you’ll be dying here, too! But no worries - dying in this kind of a tutorial is NOT a shame!! Every single attempt gives you new knowledge of the game’s mechanics. Completing this Scenario in Regular Mode with all Objectives accomplished is a truly satisfying experience!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/3c01f0a5fc4c65f9a1ad0d77643503b5c27d4c62.gif

 Additionally, we’ve implemented a special Nemesis WIKI in the game for all those who would like to dig even deeper into the game’s mechanics. It explains every aspect of the game in detail and you can access it anytime during a session.

Even more of the unique Nemesis atmosphere! 

Recreating the Nemesis atmosphere was no easy task! We put a lot of effort into every detail of the game's audio and visual aspects. Each room and event in the game now looks and sounds like a sci-fi horror experience should.

Here’s a quick look at some example stuff we implemented:

 New character models for Janitor and Lab-rat. Other models were also given a visual update:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/64e02aea580fcee627f8131e54c28fdbb153f752.gif

 New and improved animations:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/c8b956b8022343cf550914645b2faa04ac0d2f8e.gif

 New object models and improved room decorations for some locations:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/d93f4e61b0a8e98064a98729972ac62fa16e5558.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/ea815a422c53456afbd5246030a596ba47cb72f4.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/ca5f04b4467edeb1d01c049110b107266b64a6f8.png

 Important Game Events (e.g. Autodestruction) will now be significantly more prominent! (unique sounds and lighting changes)

New End-game Summary with cutscenes and some Event Phase corrections

Game Ending and Contingency resolving are crucial parts of each session and we felt that they were not presented in a clear enough manner. The full release provides a solution to this. Hopefully, the new summaries will clearly explain what happens at the very end of each session. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/f654cea80c7c704b7c048c5cc178712c9671781f.gif

We also polished up the Event Phase UI, as it’s another crucial element in each survival attempt. All pieces of information about what happened at the end of each turn will now be easier to read and follow. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/33586356aaeec63a7710723ac8c1fd122e08fd9a.gif

Cinematic cutscenes were also added at the end of each session - an additional reward for completing the game. We won’t spoil them for you - try to survive and discover them on your own!

Improved Readability and in-game information presentation 

As the game conditions in Nemesis can change drastically even within the span of a single turn (you can actually die due to just one wrong decision), it’s crucial to understand what’s going on around you. To improve those aspects we made some corrections to the game's readability and status notifications. Here are a few of those:

 New status system based on overhead pop-ups:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/1deb18babf15cd00eb9f4aa08933c7d7f7597d45.gif

 New hover system informing about wounds and exploration tokens in detail:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/c39bb77140db51e15423886de84fcb0de1dfc3cc.png

Polished UI, UX fixes and text revision 

The UI got a lot better. There are adjustments and improvements all over the (digital) board that make Lockdown a more user friendly endeavour. All texts were proofread and the in-game naming has been unified. 

Improved sections:

 Tactical Map

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/42f19146b8dd474cb0c2c1282bcf725726c922eb.gif

 Action Cards tab
 Computer Cards tab
 Intruder weakness tab
 Contingency tab

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/d4f96235b05ab6ea56deeacdbb3ee2ef0b50ab6a.gif

New social functions, team communication and server improvements 

Nemesis Lockdown shines its brightest in multiplayer, so the social aspect of the game is really important. Our team made a few improvements in this area, so you can get the best out of the multiplayer experience. 
Here’s what’s been added:

 Private game servers with passwords
 Possibility of adding your Steam friends and recently met players directly to your server
 Friends list with easy access during the game 
 Servers filtering (waiting/in-game)
 A better way of finding your disconnected games with option to rejoin 
 If the owner of the server leaves, the server will not be automatically closed now. The next player on the list becomes the owner instead
 Improved voice chat with many customization functions
 Steam Achievements - 38 in total to be unlocked at the moment! 

Apart from everything above, we have added TONS of other small changes and bug fixes that our Early Access players might notice after version 1.0 arrives! 

That is what we wanted to show you about the full release version for now. There’s lots more to be discovered and we want you to jump in and see for yourself what Nemesis: Lockdown has to offer. We hope you’ll have fun finding all the details and secrets!

We’ve also got something special for Early Access survivors! As a way of saying “thank you!” for your invaluable, ongoing support, you’ll be able to play the full version of the game ahead of everyone else. And by ahead, we mean NOW! Update the game on Steam and enjoy the improved Nemesis: Lockdown experience! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/4fe60e3b00d4fd9d494ff08a782b04c55bc48966.png

Trying to answer a few questions that might appear in your head in advance, we’ve prepared a list of some explanations:
[olist]
 “Will the Ladderboard be cleaned after Launch?” - Yes. Our current plan is to perform seasonal ladder resets - more about the topic will be announced in further updates. Current EA Top Players will of course be highlighted on the list. You’ve still got a few days until the wipe, so this is a great time to jump up on the leaderboard.
 “What about localizations?” - the game will be translated into more languages in future updates (subtitle translation) - Polish, German, French, and Chinese will be implemented as the first ones.
 “New game modes, solo campaigns - any plans for it?” - we definitely have some plans and concepts of how modes like hot-set, full-coop, or single-player campaigns could look and work. We also have more ideas in our minds…  The EA phase was a tool to make an adaptation of - let's be honest here - a complex board game. Now that we have a solid base, the full release will define the future.
 “New content in DLC? New alien races, characters, expansions, skins?” - we would love to make more DLCs - Chytrids or Carnomorphs for example. The plan is to support and expand this great franchise during upcoming years - but once again, the scale will be defined by demand.
 “Solo-app from Nemesis Boardgame - will it be compatible with the digital game?” - We don’t have such plans for now.
 “I’m only a solo player - is full release for me?” - Nemesis games always show their full potential and fun in Multiplayer games, and that doesn’t change with full release. Version 1.0 is enriched with a Mini Campaign Scenario - It’s not like a serious story campaign, but it will definitely provide you with some unforgettable moments and a few unique hours of gameplay. Completing the Scenario with all Objectives done is not a simple task! The single-player mode still ensures dozens of entertaining and challenging gameplay hours.
 “I have an old PC, and the game looks quite nice. What about optimization?” - One of our priorities was to provide a game that almost every player can play and enjoy. The game has many graphics options which you can lower to your needs and PC capabilities. Check the game’s Minimum System Requirements for more details. 
 “What about a Road Map for future updates?” - We will make a revision of our current internal Road Map after the launch. Our next big goals will be shared with you probably within a month after release.
 “I found an issue/bug in the game - where do I send it?” - Our Discord channel is probably the best way to do it (Invitation link: https://discord.gg/F6tBvUJD6j). Join to reach other players in the Nemesis: Lockdown Community. You can also use the in-game bug report form. The other way is to send an email to app.support@awakenrealms.com
 “I would like to check each and every change in the Full Release Changelog - where to find it?” - A full and detailed changelog will be accessible from the in-game main menu. We’ll also post it in future posts. 
[/olist]
That’s all we wanted to share with you today! We sincerely hope that all changes suit your expectations and that you’re about to experience numerous memorable and unique moments in Nemesis: Lockdown! 

If you have further questions - do not hesitate to ask directly on the right Discord channel or in the comment section below. Expect some more pictures, videos and updates about the game within the next few days. If you enjoy the game - remember to leave a review on the Steam Store - it really helps and motivates us a lot! 

OK, survivors - as one final piece of new content, we leave you with the gif below that should CATch your eye!

Take care,
Awaken Realms & InterStudio teams

notes.title: Patch 0.92: Eclipse is now AVAILABLE !
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/c82ab5fb5747971753ef46dae500a8494a30321c.png

Hello survivors!

A new big patch 0.92 is now on BOARD! – We've managed to fix many of the bugs you've been reporting to us, as well as make many improvements, fixes and even changes in the UI. 

The culmination of our work are brand new features which we hope you will like and they will result in an improved gameplay process.

At this point we would also like to mention that further patches are being developed and it's only a matter of time when they will be released but we hope you will have a great time with the current version of the game and each subsequent patch will bring new upgrades and fixes and a lot of fun!

Let’s start by showing you differences between old version of the game and changes made in the current patch.

Photos showing some of the changes:

1. New elevator entrance! You no longer need to consult the tactical map to check the elevator power supply and the number of the floor you are on. Everything is clearly and legibly presented in a 3D view.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/8ae7600d7b003ddcc6bf0d2f0e8886ec639a4837.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/8430e51317ab93b288b5909ae5be62adedb5792c.jpg

3. Most of the UI elements have also been completely rebuilt. The screen shows, for example, the Peek CSS panel.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/cfd5d508afe7901be92810a551d796aa27f3177f.jpg

4. The tactical map has been exploded with a new bag of intruders, unique room ID's and room category markings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/c179dce2dbe162ce1f19d9ed2499cd3c2ec40070.jpg

5. If the main gate opens, the way to the bunker appears.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/34079ba0c38e38ed02dee0b94da8db91a7be5391.jpg

6. Brand new Backup Power Supply Room!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/e6c9df39d0c83493bb875af37c1c38f407deca32.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/314ab08089a628b389e72df6402571e8d4c9bfe5.png

New Features:


 New Hints panel on "How to do Quests" by right-clicking on a Quest.
 Room numbers added to the map.
 Player's 3D character and character name in the lobby highlighted when he speaks.
 Intruders' damage is visible on the map during the event phase.
 Changed information about Power Threshold on the map.
 Number of items in the room on icon of room status.
 Button to Card Deck when we have an empty deck.
 Timer in the Pass Button.
 Requirement Box displayed after clicking on the Rover, Main Door and Isolation Icon on the map.
 "Player Left/Join the game", "The player chose a character" text added to Lobby Chat.
 Hiding the compass and constant highlighting interactive elements added to the settings.
 Hiding the UI on the H key.
 New Contamination Room.
 Facility Outside shown after Main Gate opened.
 New Elevators.
 New Cave Entrance.
 New look of Elevator Entrances, Isolation Room and Room 4.


Reworked UI:


 CSS actions panels overhaul.
 New panel on the map showing the amount of intruders in the base and caves.
 New character statuses when the avatar is hover.
 New icons for light wounds, Slime, Isolation Room, Contaminations Card and more.
 Tooltips overhaul.


Gameplay Fixes:


 The Archive action allows you to peek a Player's Contingencies.
 Fixed Computer Action "Choose a room. Put out the Fire and the intruders retreat".
 After using the action that allows to move through the vents, players make a Noise roll.

Improvements:


 Updated logs during the event phase. Added the name of the intruder which performs the action.
 Logout Mask added to the Avatar on the map when the player leaves the game.
 Players colors added to chat.
 Corrections in marking quests as failed.
 New Sounds for Our Turn, Hide/Open Card Deck, End of Event Phase and more.

 Increased the number of red ui after death.
 Added "Pick up the corpse" over the character corpse.
 Player icons are always shown during the event phase.
 Updates to Timeline.
 Added information about the inability to use the computer to the computer modifier in the room.
 Reworked the icons above the characters.
 The player can choose the objective after dying/ using CSS/Isolation Room/ Moving to Bunker if he hasn't had a choice yet.
 Added displaying Objectives on hover.
 Added displaying Chat and System log after pressing Tab key.
 The panel informing that the player has connected/quit the game was removed.
 New log when a light wound was inflicted as a result of fire damage.
 Display of the current floor of the elevator.
 Adding avatars, voice chat support, and text chat while selecting characters.
 Monochrome 3D model in the characters panel and wounds when the player dies.


Bugfixes:

 Information about an Intruder's Attack is no longer obstructed by rolling the dice.
 When the player enters the css, the correct message is displayed above his avatar.
 Camera movement fixed for quick actions.
 Fixed Requirements for CSS Control Room action in case of 3rd round and when all CSS are revealed.
 Fixed an issue where the player could choose a character after the timer expires.
 Displaying the correct intruder card while using the action from Flashlight.

 Correction of logs in which it was written that we paid with the Wail item.

 Corrections in typos.

 A ticking sound only when we are choosing our character.

notes.title: Patch 0.91 is here!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/9dfc889cf4b241a30fb836d76eb6d7b0e2983f0c.png

Hello!

Patch 0.91 for Nemesis Lockdown is now available!

This patch has been targeted to improve quality aspects and fix many bugs, especially those, that caused freezes/crashes. We’ve also made some changes regarding action costs and improved scoreboard with detailed information about what exactly happened.

Besides that, we’ve improved the descriptions of some actions from cards and items to be more detailed, made some linguistic corrections, and ameliorated the display of player bodies after death on the tactical map. Check the detailed list below:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/314ab08089a628b389e72df6402571e8d4c9bfe5.png

Frequently reported:

 New Avatars Panel (new better indicated statuses).
 Voice and text chat is now available on the scoreboard!
 The chat and avatar panel display above other UI elements.
 Improved scoreboard (endgame steps with detailed information about what exactly happened).
 Hiding UI elements while picking Corridor (eg. silent move).
 Repository Action costs 1 move (was 0).
 It Works For Me Action costs 1 move (was 2).
 Quest Battle Suit Action costs 1 move (was 0).
 Quest Overmind is now a passive item and it will activate automatically.
  Fixed game freezing after Danger Roll and Danger Exploration Token.

Mechanics:
 
 Thermite charge and grenade can now destroy eggs in the Nest.
  Kickstopper event fix.
  Rushed Analysis can now kill you.
  Improved noise removal in the event phase.
  During the Event Phase noises are no longer removed in the Corridors connected to the Staircase we are in.
  Movement which spawned Intruder in Vents sometimes took 2 actions - now it's fixed and should take only 1 action in Player Turn.
  Fixed Cave Entrance Action - now Adult attacks like in the darkness.
  2 contingencies on start in 1 or 2 players game.

Bugs:
 
 Guard Room Action fix: bug when there were no Enviro-Suit available.
  Fixed spawn of Intruder Carcass after killing the Queen.
  Fixed Avatars and player nicknames in the scoreboard.
  Using the Neutralizer and Taser increases the limit of these craftable items by 1 (bug: items were returned to the pool 2 times).
  The quest to kill the queen has been fixed.
  Game freezing after SMG shooting.
  Items panel fix - duplicate items fix (reported by Buzz @Discord).
  No more -1 in the Scoreboard.
  Fixed popup Pay Cards to Deal Damage popup when attacking larva.
  Fixed showing CSS info when CSS token was moved with a CSS Control Room action.
  Event - Damage - no longer shows rooms that can't be damaged.
  Fixed Blood Trace Event.
  Fixed Adult spawning sequence.
  Fixed 'Facility Tour'.
  Fixed showing Noises for exploration tokens 'Slime' and 'Silence'.
  Fixed 'It Should Work' - didn't work with the elevator.
  Fixed DMG dealt when shooting from the 'Assault Rifle'.

Gameplay: 
 
 Order of players (queue fix).
  Re scale Heavy Items models (after drop): flamethrower, proto pistol, pistol, battle suit, charged rifle, proto shotgun.
  CSS info during the event phase (fix).
  Improved Objectives preview (Transmitter Control Room).
  When Intruder retreats after receiving damage it should display RUN instead 0 or miss.
  The flashlight description was updated.
  When an intruder escapes or destroys the door after an action caused by the player, a popup and information in the logs will be displayed.
  Log correction: after you pay for additional damage (advantage die) Correct amount of damage (log).
  Linguistic correction (from Discord).
  More detailed descriptions of some Actions from Cards and Items.
  Popup when intruders move (destroys the door and stays in the room).
  Correct amount of damage dealt by Vivisection.
  Improved larva shooting (no longer asking if we want to deal extra damage).
  Displaying players bodies on the tactical map.
  Interrupt fix (blank window fix).
  Tactical map - number of damage and fire fix.
  Result popup of Weird Metabolism.
  No more player body hovering from another room.
  Picking-up player body after reconnect.
  Steam avatar visible in Scoreboard (after player disconnect).
  Additional damage dealt number in light (log info fix).
  Saving Mic settings.
  Corrected descriptions of Vivisection card (actions and logs).
  Added information about the number of heavy items in the Loot Box panel.
  Adding popups to the rest of Survivor's actions (Desperate Attack, Obstinate, Distraction).
  Labrat's Sensitive Hearing Action Popup has been corrected.
  Corrected text when the dice side pops up - Pay to deal damage.
  When we select elements from the map, other elements no longer obscure them.
  Computers are shown on the map when they are explored with Card Action.
  Fixed description - "Infecting the Host".
  Popup with Action Result during attacks in (turned off animations mode).
  No longer two popups displayed while (closing door computer action).
  Added styles to the requirement box.
  Vivisection shows life of Intruder (earlier it was shown during attack but not during Vivisection).
  The sound of the game is always heard, even if the focus is not on the game.
  New room spawn logs - delayed exploration token.
  Added blank exploration token logs.
  No more male voices while moving silently when playing Xeno, Labrat or Survivor.
  Transmitter Control Room animation fix.
  Improved showing the currently speaking player in voice chat.
  Removed question about using the Pheromone action when escaping and paying with this card.
  Removed display of 'blank token' information during DANGER roll.

Photos showing some of the changes:

1. Chat on top

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/4c8813e38b38ce8e07ad698536fa364cb650b3d9.jpg

2. Displaying players bodies on the tactical map.

3. Voice and text chat available on the scoreboard

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/bac507ff4e0805cf5b961393957adc82409da787.jpg

4. Destroyed door result

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/c78af8c99ce7750a1d3feb8d444c009dffc4d6ff.png

5. Improved scoreboard (detailed information about what exactly happened)

6. Survivor action result popup

There are still more updates ahead and we'll gradually share with you new features, upgrades, and game fixes. Stay tuned for the Road Map, which will be announced pretty soon. 

Your feedback is truly important to us! Thank you for all of your reports about bugs and suggestions - it helped a lot already! It's great to have all your engagement and support!

If you haven't joined our discord community yet, you can do it right now! Chat with other survivors, ask our team or leave us feedback, which we will surely appreciate :)

notes.title: New Patch is live!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/36f2d7cf1fd534e5bc896c0a7610f9951729ac06.png

Hello everyone!

It's almost one month after we've launched Nemesis Lockdown and we want to thank you once again for all of your support and feedback that you gave to us in Steam discussions and on our Discord server. It is a pleasure to have a community like that!

Obviously, our team was working hard on improving the game and today we have just uploaded patch implementing all the improvements we were able to make! We hope that you will like all the changes - but we are obviously not done and much more is to come! 

Tl;dr - we have fixed A LOOOOT of small bugs, improved representation of some elements of the game, improved multiplayer matchmaking experience and added TONS of quality of like improvements. 


The full list of changes:


 Server list connecting issues fix
 Contamination cards scanner
 New exploration tokens: Danger and Silence
 Exploration tokens during the standard move
 Ban list: player can't rejoin after kick.
 Disconnect info messages. (Kick, Timeout, Player number exceeded, etc.)
 Maintenance Plan Action (fix)
 Defense Plan Action (fix)
 Master Plan Action (fix)
 Workspace Plan Action (fix)
 Defense Control Room Action (fix)
 Dropping Cave Plans, Thermite Charge, Antidote, Taser, Door Pilot, Grenade will spawn a good item on the ground instead of the Assault Rifle
 Fixed Sentry's card Quarantine: without power and in room with Malfunction
 Reworking the action of the Repository Room
 Action results after crafting
 Reducing the logout and reconnect message time
 New sound on activating quest items
 Adding the possibility of getting Quest Heavy Items only when we have a free slot for Heavy Item
 Added a description of Rolling Noises in Quest Item: Wail
 Drop Heavy Items fix
 Actions from Cheat Codes and Main Gate Key can be used in room with malfunction and without power
 The Event Phase starts after displaying the action result popup
 Proper action name in the Interrupt window.
 Contaminated Room can't be destroyed.
 Character panel (light fix)
 Kick player button moved to the right side.
 Improved action cards refresh
 Action result when leaving the Base
 Information about Activated and Not Activated Knowledge Token in the Knowledge Tooltip
 Add Computer to Testing Lab Room
 Fixed Vent Control Room Action
 The Elevator Action Popup now shows a right floor
 The Rest Action Popup now shows a right Player name
 Adding a description of the Neutralizer 
 Removal of Polish texts from popups
 Fixing Queen animation when she spawned as the first Intruder
 Having a Slime and Enviro-suit or Battle Suit does not cause Danger if rolls Silence
 New DMG popups
 Intruder shooting fix - damage is dealt after the animation
 Fixed intruder retreat log
 Removed hover animation when selecting an intruder
 Replacing Heavy Wounds with Serious Wounds
 Animations improvements
 Noise roll added when escaping to a bunker
 Fixed a bug related to wounding and the possibility of interacting with characters in CSS
 Fixed fire damage to characters in CSS
 Different icons designation for "Check any 2 Unexplored Rooms"

Here's a preview of some of the changes we have made:

New exploration tokens:

Danger:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/969ff3b24a6ca904130ee5466acfbba87726ade7.jpg

Silence:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/d187bcf2853215bb0bf4d2a01296271ddab3cfdf.jpg

Contamination cards scanner:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42342999/04b8181c3d0fc5fdada758002250b89931474054.jpg


We know that there's still a lot to do and more updates will come soon. In the meantime you can join our Discord server  and talk with our Community or leave us a feedback, we would appreciate that :)

Until next time!

notes.title: Server list bug - incoming hot-patch
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

Just a quick info on a small bug that you might be experiencing that we are currently hot-fixing. While we have tested our servers capacity before the launch and everything worked great – there is one small bug that showed up and might be unfortunately quite annoying. 

Displaying multiplayer games / ranking can go on and off, due to so many servers being created – which in turn might make it hard to join a game of your choosing. While this is just a simple display glitch – it might be quite annoying and we are really, really sorry for that happening! 

As we speak, our brave dev team (even it is night in Poland) is working for a hot-fix that will deal with this problem ASAP. We hope that within next few hours we will release quick-patch. Worst case scenario, solution will be tomorrow. 

Please accept our deepest apologies if this problem affect you – obviously this should not happened. Also – there are few reports of other bugs / problems – we are looking at them as well and will be fixing everything as well (non-critical bugs might take few days more).
